item.description: Complete real-world DevOps pipeline simulation featuring automated CI/CD workflows, Dockerized deployments, and scalable cloud-ready architecture using GitHub Actions and AWS.
item.content:encoded:
DevOps Accelerator

A complete real-world DevOps project designed to simulate production-grade CI/CD workflows, automated deployments, and scalable infrastructure management.

This project integrates GitHub Actions for continuous integration, Docker for containerization, and AWS EC2 for deployment automation.

item.title: EC2 + S3 Static Hosting on AWS
item.author: help@rajvardhansingh.in (Rajvardhan Singh)
item.dc:creator: Rajvardhan Singh
item.description: Beginner-friendly AWS cloud project demonstrating static website hosting using Amazon EC2, S3 Bucket integration, and Nginx web server configuration.
item.content:encoded:
EC2 + S3 Static Hosting

A cloud deployment project focused on hosting static websites using AWS services.

The infrastructure uses Amazon EC2 as the web server, Amazon S3 for static assets, and Nginx for reverse proxy and performance optimization.

  • AWS EC2 Server Setup
  • S3 Bucket Integration
  • Nginx Configuration
  • Cloud Hosting Fundamentals
